how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: النص لازم يبقى أرقام قبل ما أي حاجة تحصل له.
sentences.en: Text has to become numbers before anything can happen to it.

sentences.ar: الأول tokens: مش كلمات ومش حروف قطع متختارة بالتكرار، وعشان كده الكلمة النادرة بتكلّف كذا token والشائعة بتكلّف token واحد.
sentences.en: First tokens: not words, not letters — pieces, chosen by frequency, which is why a rare word costs several tokens and a common one costs a single token.

sentences.ar: وبعدها كل معرّف token بيبقى vector، وبنزوّد الموضع، لأن الـattention لوحدها ما عندهاش أي فكرة عن ترتيب أي حاجة.
sentences.en: Then each token identifier becomes a vector, and position is added, because attention on its own has no idea what order anything came in.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي الميكانيزم اللي المجال كله متبني عليه، صغير كفاية إنك تتابع كل رقم: تمن أبعاد، وراسين، وblock واحد، وستميّة وستة وتسعين وزن،
sentences.en: Now the mechanism the whole field is built on, small enough to follow every number: eight dimensions, two heads, one block, six hundred and ninety-six weights,

sentences.ar: وكل واحد فيهم بيتضرب على الشاشة.
sentences.en: and every one of them is multiplied on screen.

sentences.ar: كل token بينتج تلات إسقاطات query وkey وvalue.
sentences.en: Each token produces three projections — a query, a key and a value.

sentences.ar: والـquery بتاع الـtoken اللي بنبصّ عليه بيتقارن بالـkey بتاع كل token، وبينتج شبكة من الدرجات الخام.
sentences.en: The query of the token we are looking at is compared against the key of every token, producing a grid of raw scores.

sentences.ar: وبعدها الـcausal mask بيطفّي المستقبل، لأن نموذج بيتنبّأ بالـtoken الجاي مش مسموح له يبصّ قدام.
sentences.en: Then the causal mask greys out the future, because a model predicting the next token must not be allowed to read ahead.

sentences.ar: وبعدها الـsoftmax بيحوّل الدرجات الباقية لأوزان، ولاحظ إن كل صف مجموعه واحد بالظبط ده توزيع على إنت هتدّي انتباه لإيه.
sentences.en: Then softmax turns the remaining scores into weights, and notice that every row sums to exactly one — it is a distribution over what to pay attention to.

sentences.ar: والـvalues بتتمزج بالأوزان دي وتتكتب في الـresidual stream، وهو الحاجة اللي كل block بيقرا منها ويكتب فيها.
sentences.en: The values are blended by those weights and written into the residual stream, which is the thing every block reads from and writes back to.

sentences.ar: ركّب blocks، وفي الآخر النموذج بينتج توزيع على الـtoken الجاي. مش إجابة توزيع.
sentences.en: Stack blocks, and at the end the model produces a distribution over the next token — not an answer, a distribution.

sentences.ar: والـtemperature بتفرد أو بتحدّد التوزيع؛ والـtop-p بتقص ديله.
sentences.en: Temperature flattens or sharpens it; top-p truncates its tail.

sentences.ar: خد token واحد بالعيّنة، ضيفه، وشغّل الكومة كلها تاني. دي هي الـgeneration.
sentences.en: Sample one token, append it, and run the whole stack again — that is generation.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A piece of text, often a word fragment, that a language model reads as one unit; rare wor…
concepts.failure: Assuming one token equals one word; rare words split into several pieces.

concepts.def_en: The Transformer mechanism where each token scores all others by relevance and blends thei…
concepts.failure: Believing attention knows word order by itself; position information must be added separa…

concepts.def_en: A request to a database or search system to fetch, filter or change data; in SQL, usually…
concepts.failure: Blaming hardware for a slow query when a full table scan is the cause.

concepts.def_en: A triangular mask in attention that blocks each token from seeing later tokens, so next-token prediction cannot read ahead.
concepts.def_ar: mask على شكل مثلث في الـattention بيمنع كل token يشوف اللي بعده، عشان التنبؤ بالـtoken الجاي ما يبصّش قدام.
concepts.failure: Skipping the mask in training; the model then cheats by copying future tokens.

concepts.def_en: How values spread across their possible range; a sampling distribution is the shape that…
concepts.failure: Judging data by its average alone and ignoring its spread and shape.

concepts.def_en: The main information pathway through a Transformer: every block reads the running vector from it and adds its result back.
concepts.def_ar: المسار الرئيسي للمعلومات جوه الـTransformer: كل block بيقرا منه الـvector الحالي ويكتب نتيجته فيه تاني.
concepts.failure: Thinking each block replaces the vector; blocks add to the stream rather than overwrite it.

concepts.def_en: A sampling setting that flattens or sharpens the next-token probability distribution: low is predictable, high is more varied.
concepts.def_ar: إعداد في الـsampling بيفرد توزيع احتمالات الـtoken الجاي أو بيحدّه: قيمة قليلة ردود ثابتة، وقيمة عالية ردود أكتر تنوع.
concepts.failure: Expecting temperature zero to guarantee truth; it makes output repeatable, not necessarily correct.

concepts.def_en: A sampling rule that keeps only the smallest set of likeliest tokens whose probabilities add up to p, trimming the unlikely tail.
concepts.def_ar: قاعدة sampling بتحتفظ بأصغر مجموعة من الـtokens الأكثر احتمالاً اللي مجموع احتمالاتها يوصل p، وبتقص الديل الضعيف.
concepts.failure: Confusing top-p with temperature; top-p truncates the tail, temperature reshapes the whole distribution.

metaphors.metaphor: Text → token tiles → vectors rise; Q·K beams form attention weights; heatmap matrix; residual river; next-token probability bars (§6.17)

**Vector galaxy**: meaning as position; query probe; nearest neighbours ignite (cosine); a document **shatters into chunks**; top-k pulled from thousands; reranker conveyor; **context tunnel** with a limit, where middle chunks fade (lost in the middle); "retrieval is a query, not permission" access gate; agent loop inside **two guard rings**
metaphors.failure_fix: Hallucination = red corrupted branch → grounding with citations; vocabulary mismatch → hybrid search

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Pulse a target 1-4 times.
Text broken into tokens that stream past (optionally with ids).
Beams from a focus token to the tokens it attends to.
A token x token attention matrix (<= 16 tokens).
Bars (single or stacked) with token colours; values carry refs.
An embedding galaxy of seeded clusters (<= 1,500 points); a query probe finds nearest neighbours.
A target shatters into seeded blocks.
A context window as a tunnel; items enter and the oldest are evicted on overflow.
An agent loop (plan -> act -> observe) with guard checkpoints that can block a step.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
